events.title: Demo Update: Recycling, Standalone Milestones and Clearer Black Core Guidance
events.summary: Demo Update: Recycling, Standalone Milestones and Clearer Black Core GuidanceThis update reworks the path from a new game to research, along with the Black Core Base, ability progression and item destinations. In a standard new game, energy points come from recycling: keep machines processing and send their output downstream, or switch their output to recycling to build up energy. Recipes and the encyclopedia show actual recycling values to help you compare production lines.Additions and changes

events.title: Demo Update — October 1: Multi-World Canvas, 3D Planets and Scenic View Fixes
events.summary: Hello, factory builders!This Demo update brings improvements to factory canvases, planet displays and everyday controls. events.title: Demo Language Update: Now Supporting 8 Languages
events.summary: Hello everyone! The Industry Unbound Demo has a new language update.Alongside Simplified Chinese and English, we've added Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish (Spain). The Demo now supports eight interface languages.Choose your language in the top-right corner of the main menu, or change it in the game settings.
